name: vnprobe
description: apple/fgx#467: every namei path gives back the vnode references it takes.  Eighty directories, more than the 64-vnode pool, once per path: mkdir, create, stat, stat of '..', rename, unlink, rmdir.  A leaked parent reference pins every directory and the next phase answers ENFILE; a clean run is its own control, since each phase touches more distinct vnodes than the pool holds.
